_comment: Demo quest proving the JSON-driven generate_npc path (research/PROCGEN_NPC_FORMS.md §11). on_start fires generate_npc with an INLINE recipe (no file dependency, exercises ProcgenNpc::Generate directly). The minted TESNPC_ + ref are tracked and co-saved by ProcgenNpc, so after save/reload the NPC is REBUILT at its spot (logical persistence — see the doc's caveats: a fresh base/ref, old ref FormID/aliases/relationships do not carry over). NOTE: SkyrimAdapter::StartDemoQuest loads demo_court_wizard.json by default; point it at this file to run this demo, OR just cast the 'C++: Conjure NPC' spell (needs no quest).
